Publications



2025



A Systematic Literature Review of Transfer Learning for Eye Tracking
ICADEIS 2025 · Conference paper · IEEE
A review of 29 studies (2018–2024) showing how transfer learning addresses data scarcity and individual variability in gaze classification and estimation, with best practices for preprocessing and fine-tuning.





2024



Robust Fetal Head Circumference Calculation on Ultrasound Images Using Just-in-Time Compiled Ellipse Fitting
TENCON 2024 · Conference paper · IEEE
A fast, memory-efficient method based on JIT-compiled Randomized Hough Transform ellipse fitting, reaching Dice 0.93 and Hausdorff 3.88 mm in 0.41 s per image with under 800 kB of memory.


Personalized medicine meets artificial intelligence: beyond “hype”, towards the metaverse
Informatics for Health and Social Care · Book review · Taylor & Francis

title: Curriculum Vitae
text:
Projects

A Hybrid Deep Learning Approach for Accurate Eye Movement Classification
Master’s thesis · 02/2025 – 06/2025
A lightweight hybrid deep learning model for near real-time eye-movement classification, achieving over 91% F1-score on the GazeCom dataset with only a 20 ms input window, enabling low-latency gaze interaction for assistive technologies.


ACL and Dynamic Control List in Software-Defined Networks with Floodlight Controller
Bachelor’s final project · 09/2017 – 11/2017
A desktop application to manage outbound packet flow via Access Control Lists, extended with a Dynamic Control List that builds firewall rules automatically in collaboration with a honeypot.
